summary: Tested new features: campaign last_error field + banner and per-target health/remove-groups. 5/5 backend pytest tests pass (new campaigns include last_error=null; /start clears last_error then loop sets 'No accounts available in the selected section.' when the batch is empty; GET /campaigns/{id}/targets-health correctly classifies dead/failing/ok/unknown with proper counts, last_error surfacing, and dead-first ordering; 404 for missing campaign; remove-groups pulls specified groups, returns 400 on empty payload and 404 on unknown campaign). Frontend tested via Playwright: Targets dialog opens, target-row entries render with per-row remove buttons and Remove-all-dead action, Targets count on card decrements after removal, and the red 'Stopped: <last_error>' banner (campaign-last-error-<id>) renders correctly when last_error is set. SAFETY: no real campaign was started against real accounts; the no-accounts test inserted the campaign directly into Mongo with a fake batch_id so the loop hit the empty-section branch and stopped without any Telegram calls. All throwaway campaigns/logs cleaned up. zydex was not touched.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 775 lines — approaching 700-line guideline; consider splitting campaign/account/proxy modules.
targets_health aggregation uses $last after $sort by timestamp — correct, but note lexical sort works only because ISO-8601 timestamps are stored as strings; keep the sort stage.

campaign_loop no-accounts branch writes a synthetic log with account_id=None and group_id='-'; that row will show up under GET /logs and could pollute stats. Consider a separate 'system' status or skipping the log for the placeholder group.
start_campaign clears last_error before task creation — race is fine because campaign_loop only overwrites on real error. Good.
seed_data_creation: All throwaway campaigns and seeded logs deleted after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_targets_health_and_last_error.py. Never call /start on a campaign that would touch real accounts — use direct Mongo insertion with a fake batch_id (see test_start_clears_last_error_no_accounts_branch) to exercise the no-accounts branch safely. 256 live accounts + zydex campaign exist in this DB.
